summary: Iteration 338 validation — vehicle-listing guard word-boundary fix, affiliate 3% commission model, and contractor@bidvex.com email. All backend suites green (109 tests). Frontend Affiliate Dashboard shows updated 3% copy in both the referral-link card description and the 'Get Paid' how-it-works step; no legacy '$10 CAD platform credit' copy remains.
critical_code_review_comments: vehicle_listing_guard.py + word_match.py: word-boundary matcher looks solid, ambiguous-token weighting reasonable; consider adding a metric/counter for gate-hits vs false-positive reversals for ongoing monitoring.

routes/affiliate.py: award_affiliate_commission idempotency key (source, reference_id) works; recommend adding an index on platform_credits {source:1, reference_id:1, referrer_id:1} to guard against races.

routes/misc.py::/api/affiliate/stats: commission_rate is returned as a hardcoded string '3% of platform profit'. If the constant AFFILIATE_PROFIT_SHARE_RATE ever changes, this string must be updated in lock-step — worth deriving it dynamically from the constant.

AffiliateDashboard.js hardcodes the same 3% copy in EN+FR. Same drift risk as above — consider a shared config or reading from /api/affiliate/stats.commission_description as the display source of truth.

The buyer login redirects to /marketplace, not /dashboard. The seed doc in /app/memory/test_credentials.md and any docs pointing to /dashboard/affiliate should note that the actual mount is /affiliate (not /dashboard/affiliate); either is served by the same page but the URL normalizes to /affiliate.

API-level negative test for the vehicle gate is masked by an earlier payment_method_required (402) pre-check for non-dealer sellers without a saved card. Fully covered at unit level in test_iter338_guard_affiliate_emails.py — no action needed, just documenting.
